newsHighlights.title: Xiamen section of Xiamen-Jinmen Bridge joined
newsHighlights.summary: The Xiamen section of the Xiamen-Jinmen Bridge was joined on Tuesday morning, ahead of a scheduled year-end opening, as builders hoisted the final 3,318-metric-ton steel box girder into place.
newsHighlights.translation: 厦门—金门大桥厦门段于周二上午完成合龙，计划于年底通车；建设者将最后一段重达3318公吨的钢箱梁吊装到位。

newsHighlights.title: Xi's Vision: Why Shenzhen?
newsHighlights.summary: Shenzhen's rise from a fishing village to a global innovation hub shows how technology and bold reform can reshape a city within a single generation.
newsHighlights.translation: 深圳从渔村崛起为全球创新高地，展示了科技与大胆改革如何在一代人之内重塑一座城市。

newsHighlights.title: Hangzhou across 5,000 years: From ancient Liangzhu to the future
newsHighlights.summary: Hangzhou showcases how a 5,000-year-old civilization can coexist with a booming digital economy powered by artificial intelligence and e-commerce.
newsHighlights.translation: 杭州展示了拥有五千年历史的文明如何与由人工智能和电子商务驱动的蓬勃数字经济共存。

newsHighlights.title: China's import expo hits record $85+ billion in intended deals
newsHighlights.summary: China's import expo reached a record of over 85 billion US dollars in intended deals, with AI products and smart equipment among the most sought-after exhibits.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国进口博览会意向成交额创下逾850亿美元的历史新高，人工智能产品和智能装备成为最受追捧的展品。

newsHighlights.title: Trump says 'positive momentum' toward ending US-Iran conflict
newsHighlights.summary: The US president said there is positive momentum toward ending the conflict after talks with several Gulf states, though diplomats warn that implementation remains the key test.
newsHighlights.translation: 美国总统表示，在与多个海湾国家会谈后，结束冲突出现了积极势头，但外交人士警告称，落实承诺才是关键考验。

quote.quote: The advance of technology is based on making it fit in so that you don't really even notice it, so it's part of everyday life.
quote.author: Bill Gates
quote.translation: 技术的进步在于让它融入生活，以至于你几乎察觉不到它，它已成为日常生活的一部分。
quote.explanation: 这句话强调真正伟大的技术不是炫目夺人，而是自然地融入日常。正如新闻中的跨海大桥、人工智能与数字经济，科技的最高境界是让人们在不知不觉中受益。

vocabulary.example: Builders hoisted the final 3,318-metric-ton steel box girder into place on Tuesday morning.
vocabulary.translation: 建设者于周二上午将最后一段重达3318公吨的钢箱梁吊装到位。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自厦门—金门大桥厦门段合龙报道中的“hoisted the final 3,318-metric-ton steel box girder”。

vocabulary.definition: 提升，吊起，举起（尤指用机械）
vocabulary.example: Heavy-duty cranes were used to hoist the massive steel component above the sea.
vocabulary.translation: 重型起重机被用来把巨大的钢结构吊装到海面之上。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自同一桥梁合龙新闻中“Builders hoisted the final... girder into place”。

vocabulary.definition: 里程碑，重大事件，转折点
vocabulary.example: The joining of the Xiamen section marks a major milestone ahead of the year-end opening.
vocabulary.translation: 厦门段的合龙标志着年底通车前的一个重大里程碑。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联厦门—金门大桥建设节点新闻，报道强调合龙是通车前的关键节点。

vocabulary.example: The bridge is part of a new wave of transport infrastructure linking Fujian with Taiwan.
vocabulary.translation: 这座大桥是连接福建与台湾的新一波交通基础设施的一部分。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自厦门—金门大桥报道，该桥属于重大跨境交通基础设施工程。

vocabulary.example: Shenzhen has grown into a global innovation hub in just a few decades.
vocabulary.translation: 深圳在短短几十年间已成长为全球创新高地。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自“Xi's Vision: Why Shenzhen?”报道，深圳以科技创新与改革著称。

vocabulary.definition: 展示，展现；展示橱窗，展示会
vocabulary.example: Hangzhou showcases how a 5,000-year-old civilization can coexist with a digital economy.
vocabulary.translation: 杭州展示了拥有五千年历史的文明如何与数字经济共存。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自“Hangzhou across 5,000 years”报道，用于描述城市对历史与科技的展示。

vocabulary.example: The import expo recorded more than 85 billion dollars in intended deals.
vocabulary.translation: 进口博览会录得逾850亿美元的意向成交额。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自CGTN关于进博会的报道“$85+ billion in intended deals”，intended 表示“意向中的”。

vocabulary.example: Shenzhen's development reflects a long-term vision for science and technology.
vocabulary.translation: 深圳的发展体现了对科学技术的长远愿景。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题“Xi's Vision: Why Shenzhen?”，vision 指发展愿景与远见。

vocabulary.definition: 前沿的，尖端的，最先进的
vocabulary.example: AI products and smart equipment were among the most cutting-edge exhibits at the expo.
vocabulary.translation: 人工智能产品和智能装备是本届博览会上最尖端的展品之一。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联进博会报道，AI与智能装备展品代表前沿技术水平。

vocabulary.example: The president said there is positive momentum toward ending the conflict.
vocabulary.translation: 总统表示，结束冲突出现了积极势头。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自CGTN报道标题“Trump says 'positive momentum' toward ending US-Iran conflict”。

pattern.pattern: ahead of + 名词/时间：在……之前，领先于（某计划或某时点）
pattern.example: The Xiamen section of the Xiamen-Jinmen Bridge was joined on Tuesday morning, ahead of a scheduled year-end opening.
pattern.translation: 厦门—金门大桥厦门段于周二上午完成合龙，早于计划中的年底通车。
pattern.usage: 常用于新闻中表示某事提前完成或发生在某个预定节点之前。常见搭配：ahead of schedule（提前）、ahead of time（提前）、ahead of the deadline（在截止日期前）。

grammar.title: 数量词 + 单位构成复合形容词（Number-Unit Compound Adjectives）
grammar.explanation: 在新闻英语中，常用“数字 + 单位 + 名词”构成复合形容词修饰后面的名词。注意：复合形容词中的名词必须用单数形式，并用连字符连接；若修饰复数名词，复数体现在最后的中心名词上。例如 3,318-metric-ton（3318公吨的）作定语修饰 girder，而不能写成 3,318-metric-tons。这一结构在科技与工程报道中尤其常见，因为它能精确简洁地传达数据。
examples: Builders hoisted the final 3,318-metric-ton steel box girder into place.
Hangzhou is home to a 5,000-year-old civilization that is now racing toward a digital future.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第一个音节 IN-frə-struk-chə。注意两点：一是第二个音节弱读为 /ə/，不要发成 /freɪ/；二是词尾 -ture 在美音中常读作 /tʃər/，英音读 /tʃə/，不要读成“true”。可以拆成四拍练习：IN-frə-STRUK-chə。
examples: The bridge is a key piece of transport infrastructure in Fujian province.
Investment in digital infrastructure has accelerated the growth of AI companies.

reading.title: Engineering and Innovation Power China's Next Chapter
reading.content: On Tuesday morning, the Xiamen section of the Xiamen-Jinmen Bridge was successfully joined, ahead of a scheduled year-end opening. Builders hoisted the final 3,318-metric-ton steel box girder into place, marking a major milestone for one of the region's most ambitious infrastructure projects. Engineering achievements like this often go hand in hand with technological progress. Shenzhen, once a small fishing village, is now a global innovation hub where cutting-edge research in artificial intelligence and smart manufacturing attracts talent from around the world. Hangzhou tells a similar story: a 5,000-year-old civilization now hosts a booming digital economy. At the same time, China's import expo hit a record of more than 85 billion dollars in intended deals, with AI products among the most popular exhibits. Together, these stories show that technology delivers the greatest value when it becomes part of everyday life, quietly lifting living standards and connecting people.
reading.translation: 周二上午，厦门—金门大桥厦门段顺利完成合龙，早于计划中的年底通车。建设者将最后一段重达3318公吨的钢箱梁吊装到位，为这一地区最具雄心的基础设施工程之一树立了重要里程碑。此类工程成就往往与技术进步相伴而行。深圳曾是一座小渔村，如今已成为全球创新高地，其在人工智能和智能制造领域的前沿研究吸引着世界各地的人才。杭州讲述着类似的故事：一座拥有五千年历史的城市如今孕育着蓬勃的数字经济。与此同时，中国进口博览会意向成交额创下逾850亿美元的新高，人工智能产品成为最受欢迎的展品之一。这些故事共同表明：当技术融入日常生活、悄然提升生活水平并连接人群时，它才发挥出最大的价值。
reading.sourceNote: 本文根据今日真实新闻改写，素材来源：ChinaDaily《Xiamen section of Xiamen-Jinmen Bridge joined》《Xi's Vision: Why Shenzhen?》《Hangzhou across 5,000 years: From ancient Liangzhu to the future》及 CGTN《China's import expo hits record $85+ billion in intended deals》，语言难度按中级英语学习者水平简化。
